records.jp: 愛央ってこういう望遠鏡とかで星を観たこと、ある？
records.en_original: Ao, have you ever stargazed with a telescope like this?
records.en_auxiliary: Ao, have you ever stargazed with a telescope like this?
records.en: Ao, have you ever stargazed with a telescope like this?

records.jp: プラネタリウムなら行ったことあるけど……。<CR>望遠鏡で本物の星を観たりしたことはないなあ
records.en_original: I've been to a planetarium, but I've never actually used a telescope to look at stars.
records.en_auxiliary: I've been to a planetarium, but I've never actually used a telescope to look at stars.
records.en: I've been to a planetarium, but I've never<CR>actually used a telescope to look at stars.

records.jp: あー、プラネタリウムも楽しいよねえ。<CR>ああいう一面の星空って普段は見れないし
records.en_original: Ah, planetariums are fun! Usually the sky isn't quite as filled with stars like it is there.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, planetariums are fun! Usually the sky isn't quite as filled with stars like it is there.
records.en: Ah, planetariums are fun! Usually the sky isn't<CR>quite as filled with stars like it is there.

records.jp: でも、自分で星を探して観るのも楽しいよ！
records.en_original: But I like searching for stars by myself too!
records.en_auxiliary: But I like searching for stars by myself too!
records.en: But I like searching for stars by myself too!

records.jp: 家の近くだと星って全然見えなかったからなあ
records.en_original: I couldn't see any stars from where I lived.
records.en_auxiliary: I couldn't see any stars from where I lived.
records.en: I couldn't see any stars from where I lived.

records.jp: まあ、都会だとそうだよね
records.en_original: That makes sense. You lived in the city, right?
records.en_auxiliary: That makes sense. You lived in the city, right?
records.en: That makes sense. You lived in the city, right?

records.jp: 勇希の住んでたところは？
records.en_original: What about where you lived?
records.en_auxiliary: What about where you lived?
records.en: What about where you lived?

records.jp: わりと見える方だったと思うよ。<CR>望遠鏡で星観たりも、よくしてたし
records.en_original: I could see quite a few, actually. I used my telescope all the time.
records.en_auxiliary: I could see quite a few, actually. I used my telescope all the time.
records.en: I could see quite a few, actually.<CR>I used my telescope all the time.

records.jp: 勇希は星観るの好きなんだ？
records.en_original: You're pretty into stargazing, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: You're pretty into stargazing, huh?
records.en: You're pretty into stargazing, huh?

records.jp: うん、好き。<CR>季節によって見える星座が変わったり……結構面白いよ
records.en_original: Yeah, I love it. The way the stars change with the seasons... It's a lot of fun.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I love it. The way the stars change with the seasons... It's a lot of fun.
records.en: Yeah, I love it.<CR>The way the stars change with the seasons... It's a lot of fun.

records.jp: 例えば夏の星って？
records.en_original: So, what can you see in the summer?
records.en_auxiliary: So, what can you see in the summer?
records.en: So, what can you see in the summer?

records.jp: 夏といえば、やっぱり夏の大三角形かな！
records.en_original: The Summer Triangle, of course!
records.en_auxiliary: The Summer Triangle, of course!
records.en: The Summer Triangle, of course!

records.jp: あー、七夕伝説の
records.en_original: Oh, the one from the story of Tanabata.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, the one from the story of Tanabata.
records.en: Oh, the one from the story of Tanabata.

records.jp: 七夕に関係あるのはそのうちの二つだけどね。<CR>織姫のベガと、彦星のアルタイル
records.en_original: Yeah—but only two of those stars have to do with Tanabata. Vega and Altair.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah—but only two of those stars have to do with Tanabata. Vega and Altair.
records.en: Yeah—but only two of those stars have to do<CR>with Tanabata. Vega and Altair.

records.jp: でも、あの時期って雨が多いから、<CR>観れないことも多いんだよねえ
records.en_original: It's hard to see them, though... It's always raining around that time of year.
records.en_auxiliary: It's hard to see them, though... It's always raining around that time of year.
records.en: It's hard to see them, though... It's always<CR>raining around that time of year.

records.jp: 確かに、まだ梅雨だもんね
records.en_original: Ah, right, that's rainy season.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, right, that's rainy season.
records.en: Ah, right, that's rainy season.

records.jp: まあでも、雲の向こうできっと会えてる……よね
records.en_original: Though I'm sure behind those clouds Orihime and Hikoboshi are reunited.
records.en_auxiliary: Though I'm sure behind those clouds Orihime and Hikoboshi are reunited.
records.en: Though I'm sure behind those clouds Orihime and Hikoboshi are reunited.

records.jp: むしろ、恥ずかしいから雲で隠してるのかも
records.en_original: Maybe they use the clouds for a little privacy.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe they use the clouds for a little privacy.
records.en: Maybe they use the clouds for a little privacy.

records.jp: 何それ、新解釈！<CR>そう考えると、文句言うのも悪い気がしてくるね
records.en_original: Oh, I like that! I guess I won't complain anymore when it's cloudy out.
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, I like that! I guess I won't complain anymore when it's cloudy out.
records.en: Oh, I like that! I<CR>guess I won't complain anymore when it's cloudy out.

records.jp: 例えば冬の星って？
records.en_original: So, what can you see in the winter?
records.en_auxiliary: So, what can you see in the winter?
records.en: So, what can you see in the winter?

records.jp: 冬だったら……シリウスとか？　おおいぬ座の
records.en_original: In the winter... Sirius, maybe? The one in Canis Major.
records.en_auxiliary: In the winter... Sirius, maybe? The one in Canis Major.
records.en: In the winter... Sirius, maybe? The one in Canis Major.

records.jp: なんか聞いたことあるような……？
records.en_original: Hmm, I think I've heard of that one.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm, I think I've heard of that one.
records.en: Hmm, I think I've heard of that one.

records.jp: 夜空で一番明るい星。<CR>都会でも結構見えやすいと思うよ
records.en_original: It's the brightest star in the night sky. You can even see it from the city!
records.en_auxiliary: It's the brightest star in the night sky. You can even see it from the city!
records.en: It's the brightest star in the<CR>night sky. You can even see it from the city!

records.jp: 冬は空気も澄んでるし、星を観るには丁度いいんだよね
records.en_original: The sky is really clear in the winter, so you can see the stars really well.
records.en_auxiliary: The sky is really clear in the winter, so you can see the stars really well.
records.en: The sky is really clear in the winter, so you can see the stars really well.

records.jp: でも、冬の夜に外で天体観測って、<CR>なかなか大変そうだね……
records.en_original: But stargazing outside in the winter? Sounds cold...
records.en_auxiliary: But stargazing outside in the winter? Sounds cold...
records.en: But stargazing outside in the<CR>winter? Sounds cold...

records.jp: まあねー。防寒対策必須！
records.en_original: Well, yeah. That's why you have to take drastic heating measures.
records.en_auxiliary: Well, yeah. That's why you have to take drastic heating measures.
records.en: Pretty much. Proper protection from the cold is essential!

records.jp: でも、寒い中あったかーいコーヒーとか飲みながら<CR>星を観るのもオツなもんだよ
records.en_original: But don't knock it till you try it. Stargazing with a nice hot cup of coffee is the best.
records.en_auxiliary: But don't knock it till you try it. Stargazing with a nice hot cup of coffee is the best.
records.en: But there is a special charm to watching the stars in the cold<CR>while drinking nice, hot coffee.

records.jp: ……勇希、本当に星に詳しいんだね
records.en_original: You know a lot about stars, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: You know a lot about stars, huh?
records.en: You know a lot about stars, huh?

records.jp: ふふん、まあね。あたし、学校の勉強は苦手だけど<CR>こういうのは詳しいんだ
records.en_original: Heheh, pretty much. I may be a bad student, but I know a lot about this stuff.
records.en_auxiliary: Heheh, pretty much. I may be a bad student, but I know a lot about this stuff.
records.en: Heheh, pretty much. I may be a bad student, but I know<CR>a lot about this stuff.

records.jp: わかる。趣味の知識って、学校の勉強よりも<CR>するする入ってくるよね
records.en_original: I totally get that. Learning about stuff you like is way easier than learning stuff at school.
records.en_auxiliary: I totally get that. Learning about stuff you like is way easier than learning stuff at school.
records.en: I totally get that. Learning about stuff you like is way easier<CR>than learning stuff at school.

records.jp: そうなんだよねー。<CR>なんで勉強だとダメなんだろ……
records.en_original: Definitely. I just don't know why I'm so bad at studying, though...
records.en_auxiliary: Definitely. I just don't know why I'm so bad at studying, though...
records.en: Definitely. I just don't<CR>know why I'm so bad at studying, though...

records.jp: ある意味納得かも。<CR>遊ぶのに全力な勇希らしいっていうか
records.en_original: No, that makes sense. The Yuki I know is much more worried about having fun than studying.
records.en_auxiliary: No, that makes sense. The Yuki I know is much more worried about having fun than studying.
records.en: In a way, that makes sense.<CR>It is very like you to put all your energy into having fun.

records.jp: あたしが遊んでばっかりみたいじゃん！<CR>……いや、否定できないけど
records.en_original: That makes it sound like all I do is try and have fun! ...Which is true, I guess.
records.en_auxiliary: That makes it sound like all I do is try and have fun! ...Which is true, I guess.
records.en: That makes it sound like all I do is try and have<CR>fun! ...Which is true, I guess.
